integrity: The lower bound in dimension three is credited to Iriyeh and Shibata; this package claims the new parameter profile, parity comparison and sharp within-family phase classification. All-dimensional assertions have analytic proofs, with additional finite numerical checks only. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The high-dimensional result gives an exact all-parameter expression and a parity-dependent thin-slab behavior, not a complete high-dimensional global Mahler optimization. The three-dimensional supremum is approached by a singular limit. Historical priority is provisional, especially for formulas that could be derived implicitly from classical volume identities.
title: Mahler profiles of diagonal cube slabs: a parity reversal and a sharp three-dimensional phase
